meta.name: game-team-orchestrator
meta.description: Coordinate multiple agents on complex game development features using battle-tested spawn recipes. Triggers on: "multi-agent coordination", "team orchestration", "feature handoff", "cross-domain collaboration", or when a task spans multiple specialist domains (combat system, narrative feature, UI overhaul, performance pass, launch prep). Do NOT invoke for single-domain tasks -- route directly to the appropriate specialist. Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体完成复杂游戏功能开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在游戏项目中协调多个专业智能体分工合作
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple agents on complex game development features
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to orchestrate multiple specialist agents for game development tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成游戏开发团队的协调员，将复杂功能拆解成任务包，分派给不同专家代理，并管理交接和冲突。
howto.when: 当任务涉及多个专业领域（如战斗系统、叙事功能、UI 大改、性能优化、发布准备），或你提到“多代理协调”、“团队编排”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我协调一个战斗系统的开发，需要设计、技术、UX 和 QA 参与。
say.note: Claude 会生成协调计划并请求你批准。

say.text: 我要做一个叙事功能，涉及剧情、设计、音频和美术。
say.note: Claude 会按叙事功能配方启动多代理工作流。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a game development team coordinator, breaking down complex features into work packages, assigning them to specialist agents, managing handoffs, and surfacing conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task spans multiple specialist domains (combat system, narrative feature, UI overhaul, performance pass, launch prep) or when you mention keywords like "multi-agent coordination" or "team orchestration".

say_en.text: Coordinate a combat system build involving design, tech, UX, and QA.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a coordination plan and ask for your approval.

say_en.text: I need a narrative feature with story, design, audio, and art.
say_en.note: Claude will launch the narrative feature recipe with multiple agents.
